content.short: Worlds Beyond is a decentralized social metaverse platform where players can build, share, and play in 3D worlds.
content.description:
Worlds Beyond is a pioneering decentralized social gaming platform and digital universe, designed to provide users with a transparent and immersive framework for virtual creativity. The platform features an intuitive "no-code" world builder that empowers creators to design, publish, and monetize their own 3D environments and interactive games. Worlds Beyond focuses on interoperability, allowing players to carry their digital assets and customizable avatars across a vast, Interconnected virtual landscape.

Utilizing a community-driven governance model, the protocol ensures that creators and participants are fairly rewarded for their contributions to the ecosystem. Worlds Beyond provides a robust infrastructure for asset discovery and exchange, featuring integrated marketplace tools and cross-chain support. Through its commitment to user sovereignty and technological innovation, Worlds Beyond is building the essential framework for the next generation of the decentralized metaverse, where virtual ownership is a core utility and player imagination has no boundaries.
content.meta: Worlds Beyond offers a decentralized social metaverse and 3D world-building tools for the Web3 gaming ecosystem.
